description: Disaster-recovery telemetry events for governed backups, clean-environment restore drills, recovery-tier violations, and capability degradation. Degradation events always preserve the deterministic-risk-monitoring allowance; no event may report a tier miss without its durable incident.

events.name: backup.completed
events.description: A backup run finished under a governed policy, recording artifact references and the policy dimensions that authorized the copy.

fields.name: locationRef
fields.notes: Must be in the approved failure-domain allowlist.

fields.name: keyReference
fields.notes: Opaque keyref: into the separated keystore — never key material.

fields.name: artifactRefs
fields.notes: Non-empty; each ref names a hash-verified artifact.

events.name: restore.drill.finished
events.description: A clean-environment restore drill completed with its full check ledger and credential-presence record; PASSED requires credentials present and a completion instant.

fields.name: checks
fields.type: array<{name: string, passed: boolean, detail: string}>

events.name: tier.violation.detected
events.description: A drill measurement missed its declared RPO/RTO tier; a durable incident was opened and pinned to the measurement.

fields.name: incidentId
fields.notes: Always set on violation — a miss never records without its incident.

events.name: degradation.changed
events.description: A capability's machine-readable recovery-health state changed; degraded states block confirmed-opportunity influence while deterministic risk monitoring stays allowed.

fields.name: deterministicRiskMonitoringAllowed
fields.notes: Always true while any monitoring capability exists — never suppressed alongside degradation.

fields.name: incidentId
fields.notes: Required for DEGRADED; forbidden for HEALTHY.
